correctness.rationale: Read the complete assigned RESULT.md and exact-rational verify.py. Its three-step return matrix M=[[2,2],[-2,2]] and inverse N=(1/4)[[1,-1],[1,1]] satisfy N^8=4096^-1 I; the strict prescribed quadrant conditions reduce to four halfspaces D_b centered at the known orbit r_b, and S_n=intersection_{j=0}^{n-1}N^j D_b. Since D_b is convex and contains zero, the eight residue classes of scaled copies are nested; n>=8 makes the last copy of each class controlling, proving the infinite-index homothety. The three finite b regimes use explicit polygons D_b, P_b, (2-b)Q, with affine-in-b endpoint support constraints and N-invariance. The actual checker certifies the edge-support and feasibility tests in exact rational arithmetic at interval endpoints, which analytically extends to every b in the closed regime; shoelace areas give the three C(b). Independent rational clipping checks at multiple b and n corroborated areas and the periodic homothety. The claim is CONDITIONAL survivor area only, not full basin/escape measure.
